title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30433: expose consolidated calendar entry before insert
summary: A new integration event exposes consolidated work center calendar entries and their source data before insertion, allowing extensions to preserve metadata and adjust records.
key_points: New integration event fires before consolidated calendar entries are inserted
Event provides access to filtered source calendar entries and the generated entry
Subscribers can transfer metadata or derive values from source entries
Non-handled event preserves standard insertion logic
Addresses extensibility gap when generating consolidated work center calendars
quote: adds an integration event immediately before insertion so subscribers can inspect all contributing entries and modify the consolidated entry
